# Style 03 · Neo-Brutalism

> Loud, honest, and a little unfinished.

**Keywords:** Bold · Playful · Raw · Direct · Anti-corporate  
**Mood:** Bold · Playful · Energetic  
**Sectors:** Technology & SaaS · Media, arts & culture · Retail & FMCG · Education & public sector  
**Strongest applications:** Social media · Websites · Advertising · Events · Brand identity

> **Fictional sample brand.** Klonk, project tool for creators, and every person, figure and address in its examples are invented to demonstrate this style. This is not client work. Domains use the reserved `.example` TLD.

## Concept

Neo-Brutalism exposes how the design is built: thick black outlines, flat saturated fills and hard offset shadows. It reads as confident and anti-corporate, which suits challenger brands and audiences who are used to polished, interchangeable interfaces.

## Target industries

- Tech startups and productivity apps
- Creator economy and education
- Streetwear and youth brands
- Event and festival promotion
- Gaming and digital communities

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| Canvas | `#FFFDF5` | Background | 45% |
| Ink | `#0D0D0D` | Outlines, text, shadows | 25% |
| Highlighter | `#FFE14D` | Primary fill, highlights | 12% |
| Bubblegum | `#FF7AB6` | Secondary fill | 8% |
| Electric | `#4D6BFF` | Links, info fills | 6% |
| Mint | `#3DDC97` | Success, tags | 4% |

**Rule:** Fills are always flat and always outlined in Ink. Never place two fill colours side by side without an Ink border between them.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Archivo Black** | 400 (black) | Headlines, stickers, big numbers |
| Body | **Archivo** | 400, 600 | Body copy, UI |
| Utility | **Space Mono** | 400, 700 | Labels, tags, meta data |
| Arabic | **Changa (display) · IBM Plex Sans Arabic (body)** | | Changa's heavy geometric forms hold up inside thick outlines and stickers. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 80 / 80 | 400 black | Uppercase optional, -2% tracking |
| H1 | 44 / 48 | 400 black | Sentence case |
| H2 | 24 / 30 | 600 | Archivo semi-bold |
| Body | 17 / 26 | 400 | Left aligned |
| Tag | 12 / 16 | 700 | Space Mono, uppercase |

- Headlines should feel heavy. Never use a light weight.
- Highlight key words with a yellow marker block behind them.
- Mono for anything meta: dates, counts, tags.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 24px gutter · elements may break the grid by up to 1 column
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Generous padding inside boxes (24–32px).
- **Corners:** 0–12px. Keep one radius per project.

- Every container has a 3px Ink outline.
- Hard shadow: 6px 6px 0 Ink, no blur.
- Rotate stickers and badges by -6° to 6°.
- Stack boxes and let them overlap slightly.
- Pressed states move the element into its shadow.

## Photography direction

Cut-out people and objects on flat colour, shot with flash.

- Direct flash, high contrast, real expressions.
- Cut out subjects and place them on flat palette fills.
- Add an Ink outline around cut-outs.
- Mix photo with doodles and arrows.
- Product UI screenshots framed in outlined windows.

**Sample shot list**

1. Creator mid-laugh, direct flash, cut-out (grade: `#FFE14D` → `#FF7AB6` → `#0D0D0D`)
2. Laptop with UI, flat pink background (grade: `#FF7AB6` → `#4D6BFF` → `#0D0D0D`)
3. Team high-five, overhead, flash (grade: `#3DDC97` → `#FFE14D` → `#0D0D0D`)

**Avoid**

- Soft, moody lighting
- Glossy stock photography
- Gradients over images

## Graphic elements

- Thick outlined boxes with hard offset shadows
- Rotated stickers and starburst badges
- Marker highlights behind words
- Hand-drawn arrows and underlines
- Window chrome frames (three dots, title bar)

## UI examples

- Buttons: Highlighter fill, Ink outline, hard shadow. Press moves 4px.
- Inputs: thick outline, mono placeholder.
- Cards: coloured header bar, outlined body.
- Toasts and modals look like stickers, slightly rotated.

- Primary button: `Start for free` · Secondary button: `See templates`
- Input: Project name: `Summer drop v2`
- Tags: `Design` `Due Fri` `3 files`
- Card: **Launch checklist**, 12 of 18 done, 67%

## Social media examples

- One big statement, one sticker, one product shot per post.
- Memes and reactive posts fit this style. Keep the outline system.
- Carousels can look like app screens.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | New | Stop losing files in 9 group chats. | Try it free |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | Drop day | Templates are live! | Swipe up |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | Free forever plan | Plan less. Make more. | Get Klonk |

## Website example

- Hero with a huge headline, a marker highlight and an outlined product window.
- Features as a grid of outlined cards in rotating fill colours.
- Testimonials as rotated stickers.

- **Navigation:** Product · Templates · Pricing
- **Hero eyebrow:** For creators and small teams
- **Hero headline:** Plan less. Make more.
- **Hero copy:** Briefs, files and feedback in one board. No more hunting through chats.
- **Actions:** Start for free / See templates
- **Proof row:** Boards (Drag projects from idea to done.) · Feedback (Comments pinned right on the file.) · Templates (120+ ready-made workflows.)

## Advertising campaign

**Campaign:** Group Chat Graveyard

Turns the everyday pain of files lost in chat threads into exaggerated, outlined evidence stickers.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Billboard 48-sheet (6096 × 3048 mm) | Klonk | Your files deserve better than 9 group chats. | klonk.example |
| Display MPU 300 × 250 and leaderboard 728 × 90 | | Plan less. Make more. | Try free |

- Every sticker in the ads can be printed and handed out at events.
- Wild-posting, campus and co-working sites suit this style better than premium sites.
- Banners move with hard cuts and no easing.

## Presentations

- **Cover slide:** Investor update · Q3 · **Klonk is growing fast.** · Sample deck · fictional numbers
- **Content slide:** What creators told us. Key figure **9** (chat threads per project, on average); points: Files get lost; Feedback lives in screenshots; Deadlines slip. Figures are sample data.

- Every slide is an outlined card on Canvas with a hard shadow.
- A sticker flags the takeaway on each slide.
- Product screens sit in outlined windows.

## Brand applications

Business card, letterhead and email signature for **Jo Mbeki**, Co-founder (`jo@klonk.example`, fictional).

| Application | Specification |
| --- | --- |
| Stickers | die-cut, thick black outline, sold in rotated packs |
| Merch | tote bag with one oversized word and a hard shadow |
| Office | painted outlined boxes on the walls as wayfinding |
| App icon | yellow square, black outline, offset shadow |

- The outline weight scales with size: 3px on screen, 1.5mm in print.
- Fills rotate across products but outlines are always Ink.
- Humour in copy is part of the brand. Keep it kind.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Commit to thick outlines everywhere | Soft shadows or blur |
| Use humour in copy | Thin hairline borders |
| Let things overlap | Muted pastel tints |

## Design tokens

Text in the accent colour uses `--avdl-accent-text`, which passes WCAG AA (4.5:1) on both `bg` and `surface`.

```css
[data-style="neo-brutalism"] {
  --avdl-bg: #FFFDF5;
  --avdl-surface: #FFFFFF;
  --avdl-ink: #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-muted: #3D3D3D;
  --avdl-accent: #FFE14D;
  --avdl-accent-text: #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-accent-2: #FF7AB6;
  --avdl-on-accent: #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-line: #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-font-display: 'Archivo Black', 'Arial Black', Impact, sans-serif;
  --avdl-font-body: 'Archivo', Arial, sans-serif;
  --avdl-display-weight: 400;
  --avdl-display-case: none;
  --avdl-display-tracking: -0.02em;
  --avdl-radius: 10px;
  --avdl-button-radius: 10px;
  --avdl-border-width: 3px;
  --avdl-shadow: 6px 6px 0 #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-color-canvas: #FFFDF5;
  --avdl-color-ink: #0D0D0D;
  --avdl-color-highlighter: #FFE14D;
  --avdl-color-bubblegum: #FF7AB6;
  --avdl-color-electric: #4D6BFF;
  --avdl-color-mint: #3DDC97;
}
```
